claim: For the Eisenberg–Noe clearing model on a directed \(n\)-bank ring with unit nominal liabilities, edge shares \(0<\lambda_i<1\), and strictly positive baseline slacks \(s_i=x_i+\lambda_{i-1}-1\), a single shock \(\sigma\) to bank \(0\) has exact cascade thresholds \(\tau_0=s_0\) and \(\tau_k=s_0+\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{s_j}{\prod_{i=0}^{j-1}\lambda_i}\) for \(1\le k\le n-1\): exactly \(k+1\) consecutive banks default when \(\tau_k<\sigma\le\tau_{k+1}\) for \(0\le k\le n-2\), and all \(n\) default when \(\sigma>\tau_{n-1}\), subject to \(0\le\sigma\le x_0\).
scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Applies only to a single localized shock in a unilateral directed ring with unit nominal liabilities and strictly positive baseline slacks.
Thresholds greater than the shocked bank’s available resources are not attainable in the stated shock model.
No bankruptcy costs, fire-sale losses, liquidity feedback, multiple simultaneous shocks, or bilateral rings are covered.
An exact-rational example was checked; independent audit and empirical validation have not been performed.
title: Exact cascade-depth thresholds in a heterogeneous clearing ring
